verdict.rationale: Groq documents OpenAI-compatible base_url/api_key swap, tool use, and remote MCP server support, which enables plugging into many agent frameworks that use OpenAI SDKs; but there is no first-party guide specifically targeting coding agents (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot) or named agent frameworks (LangChain, CrewAI, etc.), and community feedback raises reliability concerns for agentic workloads. missing for 10: explicit first-party integration guides naming specific coding agents/agent frameworks, independent hands-on confirmation of agent-framework compatibility, and resolution of reliability complaints (groq-comm-9, groq-comm-10) relevant to agentic use.
